newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 22.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Advance unit of mainland China's People's Liberation Army enters Hong Kong.
Chen Kwang-yu may be appointed as next attorney-general
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui says cross-strait shipping links are not direct links.
Minister without portfolio Ma Yin-jeou likely to run for Taipei mayor.
LIBERTY TIMES - Premier Lien Chan approves resignation of Council of Labour chairman Hsieh Shen-shan.
Ilan country hit by hog foot-and-mouth disease.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan to scrap lower limits of banks' reserve requirements.
Anti-money laundry law to be implemented on Wednesday.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui says time is not ripe for direct links with the mainland.
Taiwan share prices soar, but turnover shrinks.
